root_cause.description: A stale background uvicorn daemon (PID 67896) started prior to audit hardening remained active in memory. Upon the 10:35 BST London Stock Exchange market open, it scanned the portfolio, observed £50,000 unallocated cash, and initiated 4 UK equity entries before process termination.

containment_actions: Identified and forcefully terminated stale uvicorn PID 67896.
Liquidated all 4 unintended holdings back to 100% cash.
Verified 0 open positions and 0 open orders remaining.
Implemented OS-level POSIX flock SingleInstanceLock preventing concurrent engine processes.
Gated engine background execution in API routes behind explicit PRV_AUTORUN_ENGINE flag.
Disabled PRACTICE_NEW_ENTRIES_ALLOWED in settings until official baseline freeze.

accounting_ruling.rationale: Event occurred during pre-certification staging prior to the official challenge baseline freeze. The official 30-day challenge commences strictly at £50,000.00 reference base.
